instruction: 热电领域人工 gold（5 条，由 AI 预填初稿 + 人工复核修正产出）。只保留 chunk 明确提及的信息；properties.name 使用 zT/band gap/Seebeck coefficient/thermal conductivity/electrical conductivity/power factor 等标准名。

items.chunk: The highest ZT of 1.6 is achieved for Ge0.93Ti0.01Bi0.06Te at 623 K, much higher than that of pristine GeTe.
items.reviewer_note: 对照原文复核通过：zT=1.6@623K 与 Ge0.93Ti0.01Bi0.06Te 公式正确

items.chunk: zT can be enhanced to above 3 for p-type PbTe, and above 2 for n-type PbTe at 900 K with minority carrier blocking.

properties.name: zT

items.chunk: Pb or Ca doping can enhance the thermoelectric figure of merit ZT to values up to ZT ~1.7, based on an experimentally determined tau.

items.chunk: The peak zT in Zn-doped Sr5In2Sb6 (~0.4 at 700 K) is lower than the peak zT of the Ca analogue (~0.7 at 950 K). kappa_min = 0.42 Wm-1K-1.
